# Read-Only Storage Trait Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add safe, read-only storage access on top of `RawStorage` by defining the `Storage` trait in `src/storage/mod.rs`.

**Architecture:** `Storage` extends `RawStorage` and exposes bounded element access plus storage-visible slice access. It remains strictly storage-level: no tensor `shape`, `strides`, or `offset` semantics are applied here.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, raw-pointer reads, `core::slice::from_raw_parts`

**Design Docs:** `design/05-storage.md` §5.5, §5.5a, §9.0, §9.1, `design/00-coding.md` §5.1, §6.3

**Prerequisites:** W7T1 must be complete.

---

### Task 1: Implement `Storage`

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/storage/mod.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add the complete read-only storage trait**

Append the following to `src/storage/mod.rs`:

```rust
pub unsafe trait Storage: RawStorage {
    #[inline]
    fn get(&self, index: usize) -> Option<&Self::Elem> {
        if index < self.len() {
            Some(unsafe { &*self.as_ptr().add(index) })
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    unsafe fn get_unchecked(&self, index: usize) -> &Self::Elem {
        &*self.as_ptr().add(index)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn as_slice(&self) -> &[Self::Elem] {
        unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts(self.as_ptr(), self.len()) }
    }
}
```
